This project uses Yahoo finance data on the top US stock indexes, Treasury Bill Yield indexes, and individual stocks in the S & P 500, retrieved with the tidyquant package.

### Variables: `indexes.csv`

`symbol` : Stock symbol

`date` : Trading day (YYYY-MM-DD)

`open` : Price of the stock at market open (US dollars)

`high` : Highest traded price of the stock on the date (US dollars)

`low` : Lowest traded price of the stock on the date (US dollars)

`close` : Price of the stock at market close (US dollars)  

`volume` : Number of shares traded on the date

`adjusted` : Closing price adjusted to reflect any corporate actions, such as a stock split or dividend (US dollars)
